scoring_justification: Result-level compare: the checker compares the agent's computed rotational strengths to the paper-reported gold values with 1% tolerance. Recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible because the checker cannot re-run the full perturbation-theory calculation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for the three absolute rotational strengths from Table 1 of the source paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published reference values the agent is expected to reproduce; they are checkable against the source paper.

outputs.description: Absolute uniaxial rotational strengths in units of 10^{-44} c.g.s. for the three spin-forbidden transitions. The hidden checker compares each value to the paper-reported reference within a relative tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the ligand-field perturbation theory as described. No external data download is needed.
